title: Gnarled Tree Branch
summary: An Ogre greatclub dealing 2d8 Bludgeoning. Player characters cannot equip it.

fields.Availability: Ogre-only. May be obtained by disarming an Ogre, but is unusable by player characters.
fields.Base value: 16 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Tenacity: In the main hand, when you miss a melee attack, spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
